items.title: Jackie Cain and Roy Kral interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, March 22, 1998
items.q: There was a group called Eddie Getz, and he was an alto player that Roy knew in the Army actually

ctx.x: It would take some time to find them, too. Yeah, that’s great.

I used to go into clubs in Milwaukee at times that I was really too young to be in these clubs. But the club owner would kind of overlook the fact that I was there. And I would sit in with different people. There was a group called Eddie Getz, and he was an alto player that Roy knew in the Army actually, and a very good player, and a good rhythm section, I mean as good as I thought they could be at that time.
